content: scikit-fda ML layer: Classification — KNeighborsClassifier (functional kNN with functional metrics), RadiusNeighborsClassifier, NearestCentroid, DTMClassifier (distance-to-trimmed-means), MaximumDepthClassifier, DDClassifier (depth-vs-depth), DDGClassifier (generalized DD), LogisticRegression (functional logistic), QuadraticDiscriminantAnalysis (functional QDA). No LDA class (implied via NearestCentroid or depth methods). Regression — LinearRegression (scalar-on-function and function-on-scalar in one class, with regularization support), HistoricalLinearRegression (function-on-function historical), KNeighborsRegressor, RadiusNeighborsRegressor, KernelRegression (scalar response, kernel-weighted), FPCARegression (project then OLS), FPLSRegression (project then OLS via PLS). No function-on-function general regression (only historical). Clustering — KMeans (functional k-means), FuzzyCMeans (fuzzy c-means), NearestNeighbors, AgglomerativeClustering (uses functional metrics). Inference — oneway_anova, v_sample_stat, v_asymptotic_stat, hotelling_t2, hotelling_test_ind.
